description: This file is a shell script intended to manage changelog entries in a project. It includes embedded JavaScript code that manipulates the changelog Markdown file, updating entries based on PR references, and performs validation to maintain changelog hygiene and proper PR referencing.

methods.name: normalize_pr_changelog_entries
methods.description: Reads the PR number, updates the CHANGELOG.md by moving relevant entries into appropriate sections based on PR references, and ensures the changelog structure.

methods.name: validate_changelog_entry_for_pr
methods.description: Validates that the CHANGELOG.md contains the correct PR link references, that the entries are properly placed within unreleased sections, and ensures the PR changes are correctly appended at the section tail.

methods.name: validate_changelog_merge_hygiene
methods.description: Ensures that merge operations do not inadvertently remove necessary PR references in the changelog, maintaining changelog integrity post-merge.
